halfLife.notes: Steady state reached in ~7 days. Halving the dose typically takes ~5 half-lives (~5-7 days) to fully wash out. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: N-desmethylsertraline
activeMetabolite.notes: Approximately 5-10x less potent than parent compound; not considered clinically meaningful for switching decisions. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Mild CYP2D6 inhibition is generally not significant for switching to most antidepressants but may slightly raise levels of CYP2D6 substrates such as venlafaxine or paroxetine during overlap. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

maoiWashout.notes: Standard 14-day washout in both directions to avoid serotonin syndrome. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: Moderate risk of discontinuation symptoms on abrupt cessation. Lower risk than paroxetine or venlafaxine. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Available as tablets in Malaysia. No liquid formulation widely stocked at time of writing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
